## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Registered Institutions

## Intermediaries Activities Survey 2004/05

As  an  on-going  exercise  to  maintain  an  up-to-date  profile  of  the  business  activities  of securities  and  futures  intermediaries  in  Hong  Kong  and  to  assist  the  SFC  in  formulating appropriate policies, we have now commenced the Intermediaries Activities Survey for the year  ended  31  March  2005.    All  licensed  corporations  and  registered  institutions  are requested to participate in this exercise and we appreciate your continued co-operation, as in previous years, by completing and returning the survey questionnaire on or before 30 July 2005 .  We have simplified the survey this year and you can download the questionnaire (in Excel format) from the following web-site:

http://www.sfc.hk/sfc/html/EN/forms/licensing/questionnaire/questionnaire.html (Please enable Macros when opening the Excel file)

To  reduce  the  amount  of  paper  work  and  facilitate  data  analysis,  we  request  that,  where possible, you submit your completed questionnaire by e-mail or by sending a floppy disk or compact disk to us containing the related Excel file.  The Cover Sheet of the questionnaire provides the necessary instructions for returning the survey. If, for any reason, you are unable to  access  the  questionnaire  electronically,  a  hard  copy  of  the  questionnaire  can  be  made available to you upon request to your Intermediaries Relationship Manager.

Finally, you may rest assured that all information supplied will be treated in strict confidence and will not be disclosed to third party except in the form of statistics.

If  you  have  any  queries  on  the  above,  please  feel  free  to  contact  your  Intermediaries Relationship Manager.

Licensing Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission
